'''Temmin Wexley's X-wing''', also known as '''Snap Wexley's X-wing''' was a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] piloted by [[Major]] [[Temmin Wexley]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. 

==History==
===Battle of Exegol===
[[File:TemminWexleyBattleofExegol-TROS.png|thumb|300px|left|Wexley's X-wing during the Battle of Exegol]]
During the [[Battle of Exegol]], [[Resistance pilot]] Temmin Wexley flew an X-wing fighter with the [[R6 astromech droid|R6 astromech]], [[R6-D8]] as his [[astromech droid]] along with the rest of the [[Resistance]]'s [[Exegol air team|air team]]. Arriving at the planet, they were put under heavy fire by the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]]s, the [[Final Order]], with Wexley almost running into [[Seftin Vanik]]'s [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]. Although Wexley put up a fight, he was eventually shot down by [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s, crashing on the side of a [[Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
Temmin's X-wing first appeared in the [[2019]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> The ship was first identified in a Topps trading card to promote the film.<ref name="Topps" />
